item.description: A 15-year-old girl remains in the hospital as Forsyth County deputies search for the driver who struck her in a church parking lot last month. item.title: Camo-clad gunman robs LaGrange store on Groundhog Day
item.description: A man walked into a LaGrange corner store and pointed a gun at the clerk. According to LaGrange Police, the unidentified man entered the store, located at 517 Miller Street, on Groundhog Day. The masked man took cash and fled the scene. Investigators hope someone will recognize the uniquely styled camo-clad gunman.It remains unclear exactly how much cash was taken during the robbery or if any customers were inside the store at the time.
